details.description: Nova-2 Automotive is a speech-to-text model in Deepgram's Nova-2 family, tuned for automotive-oriented vocabulary rather than general-purpose recordings. Deepgram's Model Options page describes it as "optimized for audio with automotive oriented vocabulary," and its Models & Languages Overview lists it as English-only. Deepgram's newer Nova-3 generation currently ships only general, medical and pharma variants, so this automotive tuning has no Nova-3 counterpart in Deepgram's documentation.
advantages: Tuned specifically for automotive-oriented vocabulary, per Deepgram's Model Options page, rather than using the general-purpose Nova-2 model.
Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview does not group Nova-2 under its "Legacy Models" heading, unlike Nova 1, Enhanced and Base.
disadvantages: Supports English only (en, en-US), per Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview, unlike the general-purpose nova-2-general model, which the same page lists as supporting 25+ additional languages.
Deepgram's documentation gives no domain-specific accuracy (word error rate) figures for this variant.

notes: No word-error-rate or other accuracy figures specific to nova-2-automotive were found on Deepgram's maker pages, so evaluations is left empty. Deepgram's docs give only a one-line description of this variant's tuning and no further detail on what 'automotive vocabulary' covers (e.g. in-vehicle commands vs. service/dealership calls). Catalog facts (audio_input/text_output modality, /v1/audio/transcriptions endpoint) match a batch transcription model; no deprecation_date is set in the catalog and none was found on Deepgram's pages.
